about: A selection held with the Row Sequence Version it was made under: dropped, never remapped, when the version changes (ADR-0011). From dotnet/tests/ExGrid.Tests/HeldSelectionTests.cs.

cases.name: ADR-0011: the same order keeps the selection
ADR-0011: the selection is dropped when the sort order changes: dropped, never remapped
ADR-0011: versions name orders, not points in time, so any difference drops
ADR-0011: a gesture replaces the selection under the same version
